questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning to officially take something away?
explanation: Confiscate is correct - C-O-N-F-I-S-C-A-T-E. To confiscate means to officially seize or take away.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make something larger?
explanation: Amplify is correct - A-M-P-L-I-F-Y. To amplify means to increase in strength or magnitude.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make something worse?
explanation: Aggravate is correct - A-G-G-R-A-V-A-T-E. To aggravate means to make a bad situation worse. Double G at the start.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to express disagreement?
explanation: Contradict is correct - C-O-N-T-R-A-D-I-C-T. To contradict means to deny or argue against a statement.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to increase in importance?
explanation: Escalate is correct - E-S-C-A-L-A-T-E. To escalate means to increase rapidly in extent or intensity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make something smaller?
explanation: Diminish is correct - D-I-M-I-N-I-S-H. To diminish means to make or become smaller or less significant.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make an official request?
explanation: Solicit is correct - S-O-L-I-C-I-T. To solicit means to ask for something formally or urgently.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to prove something correct?
explanation: Validate is correct - V-A-L-I-D-A-T-E. To validate means to confirm that something is correct or acceptable.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to remove errors from a program?
explanation: Debug is correct - D-E-B-U-G. To debug means to identify and remove errors from computer hardware or software.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to state a formal objection?
explanation: Protest is correct - P-R-O-T-E-S-T. To protest means to express objection to something. It is also a noun.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to give an official statement?
explanation: Testify is correct - T-E-S-T-I-F-Y. To testify means to give evidence under oath in a court of law.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning to give authority to someone?
explanation: Delegate is correct - D-E-L-E-G-A-T-E. To delegate means to entrust a task to another person. Also a noun meaning a representative.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make something mandatory?
explanation: Mandate is correct - M-A-N-D-A-T-E. To mandate means to require something as a legal or official requirement.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to bring together different groups?
explanation: Integrate is correct - I-N-T-E-G-R-A-T-E. To integrate means to combine or bring together into a unified whole.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to speak against someone publicly?
explanation: Denounce is correct - D-E-N-O-U-N-C-E. To denounce means to publicly declare something to be wrong or evil.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make a process faster?
explanation: Accelerate is correct - A-C-C-E-L-E-R-A-T-E. Double C. To accelerate means to increase in speed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make unnecessary?
explanation: Supersede is correct - S-U-P-E-R-S-E-D-E. To supersede means to take the place of someone or something. Note SEDE not CEDE.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to turn away from a wrong path?
explanation: Deter is correct - D-E-T-E-R. To deter means to discourage someone from doing something through fear of consequences.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to officially allow?
explanation: Authorize is correct - A-U-T-H-O-R-I-Z-E. Also spelled authorise. To authorize means to give official permission for something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make someone feel confused?
explanation: Perplex is correct - P-E-R-P-L-E-X. To perplex means to make someone feel completely baffled or confused.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to completely destroy?
explanation: Annihilate is correct - A-N-N-I-H-I-L-A-T-E. Double N. To annihilate means to destroy completely.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to take something back?
explanation: Retract is correct - R-E-T-R-A-C-T. To retract means to withdraw a statement or take back what was said.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make valid or confirm?
explanation: Ratify is correct - R-A-T-I-F-Y. To ratify means to formally confirm or approve an agreement or decision.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to put off until later?
explanation: Procrastinate is correct - P-R-O-C-R-A-S-T-I-N-A-T-E. To procrastinate means to delay or postpone action.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make up for a mistake?
explanation: Compensate is correct - C-O-M-P-E-N-S-A-T-E. To compensate means to make up for something unwelcome.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make something very clear?
explanation: Elucidate is correct - E-L-U-C-I-D-A-T-E. To elucidate means to make something clear through explanation.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to bring out a feeling?
explanation: Evoke is correct - E-V-O-K-E. To evoke means to bring to mind or recall a feeling image or memory.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make a process effective?
explanation: Optimise is correct - O-P-T-I-M-I-S-E. Also spelled optimize. To optimise means to make the best or most effective use of something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to bring under control?
explanation: Subjugate is correct - S-U-B-J-U-G-A-T-E. To subjugate means to bring under domination or control.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make something known publicly?
explanation: Promulgate is correct - P-R-O-M-U-L-G-A-T-E. To promulgate means to make a law or decree known publicly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to restore good relations?
explanation: Reconcile is correct - R-E-C-O-N-C-I-L-E. To reconcile means to restore friendly relations between parties.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make something seem unimportant?
explanation: Trivialise is correct - T-R-I-V-I-A-L-I-S-E. Also spelled trivialize. To trivialise means to make something seem less serious.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to delay payment?
explanation: Defer is correct - D-E-F-E-R. To defer means to put off to a later time or to yield to someone else.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to prove a theory?
explanation: Substantiate is correct - S-U-B-S-T-A-N-T-I-A-T-E. To substantiate means to provide evidence to support a claim.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to reach an agreement?
explanation: Negotiate is correct - N-E-G-O-T-I-A-T-E. To negotiate means to reach an agreement by discussion.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make a problem worse?
explanation: Exacerbate is correct - E-X-A-C-E-R-B-A-T-E. To exacerbate means to make a problem or bad situation worse.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to find out by calculation?
explanation: Ascertain is correct - A-S-C-E-R-T-A-I-N. To ascertain means to find something out for certain.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to take on a responsibility?
explanation: Undertake is correct - U-N-D-E-R-T-A-K-E. To undertake means to commit oneself to a task or project.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to start something formal?
explanation: Inaugurate is correct - I-N-A-U-G-U-R-A-T-E. To inaugurate means to begin or introduce something formally.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make a protest about injustice?
explanation: Demonstrate is correct - D-E-M-O-N-S-T-R-A-T-E. To demonstrate means to show or prove something clearly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to work together for a goal?
explanation: Collaborate is correct - C-O-L-L-A-B-O-R-A-T-E. Double L. To collaborate means to work jointly with others.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make free from something?
explanation: Liberate is correct - L-I-B-E-R-A-T-E. To liberate means to set someone or something free.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to produce a creative work?
explanation: Generate is correct - G-E-N-E-R-A-T-E. To generate means to produce or bring into existence.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to officially announce?
explanation: Proclaim is correct - P-R-O-C-L-A-I-M. To proclaim means to announce officially or publicly.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to go beyond a limit?
explanation: Exceed is correct - E-X-C-E-E-D. Double E. To exceed means to go beyond a limit or to be greater than.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to keep something going?
explanation: Maintain is correct - M-A-I-N-T-A-I-N. To maintain means to cause or enable a condition to continue.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to solve a disagreement?
explanation: Resolve is correct - R-E-S-O-L-V-E. To resolve means to find a solution to a disagreement or problem.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to prevent from happening?
explanation: Prohibit is correct - P-R-O-H-I-B-I-T. To prohibit means to formally forbid by law or authority.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to make a liquid less strong?
explanation: Dilute is correct - D-I-L-U-T-E. To dilute means to make a liquid weaker by adding water or another solvent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word used in context meaning to identify a disease?
explanation: Diagnose is correct - D-I-A-G-N-O-S-E. To diagnose means to identify the nature of an illness by examination of symptoms.
